reviewType: Reported-label and pinned-source-topology audit; not sequence reanalysis

yfull.changes: Kept node names, SNP aliases and parent-child topology only. Sample data and age estimates omitted.

ftdna.method: Conservative recorded subset: at least two distinct shared defining marker names, same major lineage, compatible source ancestor anchors, no recorded conflicting shared markers, reciprocal node mapping. Marker-name evidence is not a claim of identical tree topology.

aadr.note: Exact Genetic ID joins only. Source fields remain separate from existing project classifications.
